title: On unirational varieties with poset parameterizations
summary: We use partially ordered sets (posets) to provide a canonical parameterization for the Zariski closure of the image of a semialgebraic set under a rational map whose coordinate functions are polynomials with nonnegative integral coefficients. The resulting poset parametrization of such a unirational variety allows us to translate several well-studied problems into combinatorics; e.g. reducing the problems to describing the poset associated to the variety.
